   The patient [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] the lesion
   was localized with real-time sonography. The skin was cleansed and marked. A
   total of 5 mL 1% lidocaine was used for local anesthesia. A lateral approach
   to the target was used. A 14-gauge needle, secured to a spring-loaded
   device, was advanced to the preselected target. A total of 5 biopsy
   specimens were obtained, with pre- and post-fire images documenting needle
   placement for each pass. Specimens were sent for pathologic analysis. A
   heart shaped biopsy clip was placed at the biopsy site.

   Following the procedure, the wound was cleansed and compressed. Steri-strips
   and sterile gauze were applied and the patient [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED]
   instructions.

   Images from the procedure were sent to PACS.

   Dr. Jill Gluskin was present during the entire procedure, performed the
   procedure and reviewed all pertinent imaging. There was minimal blood loss
   during the procedure.

   The patient [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] in good
   condition.
